clips.title: The story
paras: Kuray'bin watches the forest trails outside Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. The Darkspear scout guards the Horde encampment from night elf scouts.

Outside Splintertree Post, Kuray'bin watches the forest for Alliance scouts. Silverwing Sentinels patrol the canopy and send swift outrunners across the border. Their task is to gather intelligence on Horde lumber operations and defenses. Kuray'bin sends Horde fighters to hunt the outrunners before they can report to Silverwing Outpost, since scouts left unchecked can become an ambushing force.
